exact_unison_rule: Only duplicate (exact float onset, MIDI pitch) removed; no grouping or 100ms truth deduplication
independence_limits: Frozen S601 head trained on URMP only; no target labels used in training or this selection
GuitarSet and MAESTRO are among Basic Pitch pretraining datasets; no claim of globally unseen pretraining
IDMT Dataset3 and some GuitarSet material were evaluated by earlier project models; this is transfer of a frozen new head, not a new untouched corpus
MAESTRO filenames excluded against listed prior manifests only, not exhaustive project history
Microphone GuitarSet only; pickup-only, other microphones, room acoustics and user instruments remain unvalidated
Offline NoteOn only; no NoteOff, complete Exact-K, causal or Live claim
primary_measure: micro NoteOn F1, exact MIDI40..88, one-to-one matching +/-80ms

selection_rules.GuitarSet: 60 of 360 microphone recordings: 6 players x 5 filename styles x 2 roles, smallest SHA256(full filename) among 6 in each cell
selection_rules.IDMT: All five original Dataset3 WAV recordings; pathetique mono/poly are two arrangements of one work, not independent compositions
selection_rules.MAESTRO: One smallest-SHA256(audio_filename) per single canonical composer credit among official test rows duration 29..300 seconds; exclude the 35 explicitly listed earlier project sources; 12 composers

short_source_rule: Score [offset,min(offset+24,source EOF)), all three outputs on exactly that interval; fail without replacement if less than 2 seconds
